csv_scope_of_work: The County of Ottawa, on behalf of the Department of Public Health, is requesting proposals from experienced and qualified consulting firms to conduct a strategic planning study for its Environmental Sustainability (ES) Program s ES Centers. The purpose of this study is to evaluate the current Environmental Sustainability Center (ESC) service delivery model, structure, and develop a comprehensive, evidence-based strategic plan to guide a transition from leased facilities to strategically located County owned sites that enhance operational efficiency, improve safety and compliance, expand service capabilities, and support long-term program sustainability. The selected vendor will assess operational, financial, and service delivery considerations and provide recommendations that address current system needs while establishing a framework for future growth. The selected vendor will receive a contract to complete the strategic planning study.
